verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical: both are the square layout shrunk into a centred column on the wide banner, not rearranged for it. The logo pill, shoe and text card stack down the middle and leave the left and right thirds as dead confetti. 'DROP 07' and the body line ('Lightest sole...') are tiny at this size, the shoe is shrunk well below its hero role, and the card nearly touches the bottom edge while the logo sits jammed under the top edge.
